description.before: Continous 7 day retention and 30 day retention backups. Azure Cosmos DB performs data backup in the background without consuming any extra provisioned throughput (RUs) or affecting the performance and availability of your database. Continuous backups are taken in every region where the account exists.
description.after: Select a supported continuous-backup tier and retention window for business recovery needs; current documentation lists 7, 30 and 35 days. Verify API support, the latest restorable timestamp and the available backup region before restoration. Backups run without consuming additional provisioned RUs, but backups are not automatically geo-disaster resistant: add a region explicitly where needed. Recreate excluded networking, private endpoints, RBAC and other account configuration after restore and test recovery against RTO/RPO. Restore target options depend on the scenario; do not assume every restore supports an existing account.
